scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Those filthy little
creatures! Scurrying
around, snatching things
from me! If only they
weren't so blamed quick...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
那些脏兮兮的小东西！到处乱窜，抢我的东西！
要不是它们跑得那么快...

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, is that the
Sweet Rice my son made?
Would you let me have it?
Please wait here a moment,
and I'll make you some pastry~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，这是我儿子捣好的糯米吗？
能给我吗？
在这儿等一会儿，我给你做点糕点~

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, where are all the
Rice Pouches? We need
them to make more rice cakes...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哎呀，我的米袋都去哪儿了？
没有它们就没法做米糕了...

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Ooh, those white and
blue mouses might have
snatched my Rice Pouches
Those moles probably took
them too. Such nasty little
creatures, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
那些白老鼠和蓝老鼠可能偷走了我的米袋，鼹鼠大概也偷了一些。
真是些讨厌的小东西，是不是？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, is that one of my
Rice Pouches? I'm sorry,
but the pain my hips..
Would you mind being
a dear, and delivering
that to my son for me?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，这是我的米袋吗？
不好意思，我的腰疼得厉害...
能麻烦你帮我送给儿子吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
It's not nearly enough
to repay you for what you've
done for me, but I'd like
you to have this pastry that
I just made. Please enjoy it~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
这点东西远远报答不了你的帮助，不过，收下我刚做好的糕点吧。
尝尝看~

scripts.text: [Rice Mill Grandma]
scripts.translation: [碾米坊婆婆]

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, I was just making
some rice cakes and
pastries to celebrate
the new year, but these
animals have been stealing
the Rice Pouches I've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
我正做米糕和糕点，准备过年呢，可那些动物一直偷我备好的米袋。

scripts.text: Rice Pouches?
scripts.translation: 米袋？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Yes, my son needs those
Rice Pouches to pound the
rice in a mortar, but I can't
make any pastries if I don't
even have the rice. Do you
think you can help me?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
是啊，我儿子要用米袋里的米在石臼里捣糯米。
没有米，我就做不了糕点。
你能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然可以

scripts.text: I don't even know you.
scripts.translation: 我都不认识你

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course.
What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然可以。
我能做什么？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Well, do you think you
can catch the animals that
stole my Rice Pouches?
They're these blue and
white rats and these
nasty little moles.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
你能帮我抓住偷米袋的动物吗？
就是那些蓝老鼠、白老鼠，还有讨厌的小鼹鼠。

scripts.text: Not a problem.
scripts.translation: 没问题

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not a problem.
I'll catch those animals,
and bring back any Rice
Pouches that I can find.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没问题。
我会抓住那些动物，尽量把米袋找回来。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, thank you!
Good luck catching
those pests for me~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，谢谢你！
祝你顺利抓到那些小坏蛋~

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
I... Well...
That's true, but I was
planning on giving you
something nice in return
for your help. I know you're
not a bad person, so...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
我...嗯...你说得没错。
不过，我会送你些好东西，报答你的帮助。
我知道你不是坏人，所以...

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Thank you for the
Sweet Rice! I'll be
sure to make something
delicious for you if you
bring me more, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
谢谢你带来的糯米！
再带些来，我一定给你做好吃的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Breaks my heart...
My mom spends all this
time preparing rice for
the new year, and it's all
stolen by rats and vermin!
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
真让人心疼...
妈妈花了那么多时间准备过年的米，结果都被老鼠和那些小害兽偷走了！

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
I hear from my mother
that you're helping her out.
She's a sweet old lady, huh?
If you find ang Rice Pouches,
you might want to have her
inspect them first.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
妈妈说你正在帮她。
她是个很和蔼的老人，对吧？
找到米袋的话，最好先拿给她检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
If you bring me some
Rice Pouches, then I can
pound into into Sweet Rice.
You're here to help out my
mother, right? Thanks,
I really appreciate that.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
给我些米袋，我就能把里面的米捣成糯米。
你是来帮妈妈的吧？谢谢，真是太感激了。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Oh, you brought me some
Rice Pouches from my mother?
Give me a second, and I'll
get this rice pounded into
paste, lickety split.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
哦，你从妈妈那里带来了米袋？
等一下，我很快就把米捣好。

scripts.text: [Rice Mill Man]
scripts.translation: [碾米坊的男子]

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Hoo! Haa! Hi-yah!
Woosha! Whoosha!
Ka-taaaaaaaaaa!
WOOOSHA!
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
Hoo! Haa! Hi-yah!
Woosha! Whoosha!
Ka-taaaaaaaaaa!
WOOOSHA!

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
All done. Here, this
Sweet Rice is ready to
be made into pastries
Would you please bring
this to my mother?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
好了，给你，这些糯米可以做糕点了。
能帮我带给妈妈吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, I'm sorry, but we
can't do any business if
you're carry so much stuff.
Would you mind storing some of
your things with the Kafra Service?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不好意思，你身上的东西太多了，没法交易。
能先用卡普拉服务存放一些物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I want to earn enough
money to buy that big
crescent silver pin.
I have to sell as much
of this Mojji as I can!
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我想赚够钱，买那枚大大的新月形银别针。
得多卖些米糕才行！

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, hello! I'm selling
special rice cakes made
from sweet rice. You can
eat it yourself, or feed it
to your New Year Doll if
you have one as a pet.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你好！我在卖用糯米做的特制米糕。
可以自己吃，如果养了新年娃娃，也可以喂给它吃。

scripts.text: [Lunar]
scripts.translation: [露娜]

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Anyway, I'm selling
10 Mojji for 3,000 zeny
Would you like to try some?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
10个米糕只要3,000 Zeny。
要尝尝吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Thank you, and I hope you
have a happy new year!
Please come again~
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
谢谢，祝你新年快乐！
欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny right now....
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不好意思，你现在的Zeny不够...

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, alright. Well, I'll
be here if you or your
friends want some Mojji
later, alight? Goodbye~
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
好吧，你和朋友以后想吃米糕，随时来找我。
再见~
